headline_seed: India’s Snabbit closes $56M round as investor interest in on-demand home services heats up
description_seed: Snabbit now processes over 40,000 daily jobs and has cut costs sharply as it expands across cities and services.

what: India’s Snabbit closes $56M round as investor interest in on-demand home services heats up

clean_source_blocks.text: Snabbit now processes over 40,000 daily jobs and has cut costs sharply as it expands across cities and services.
Snabbit, an Indian on-demand home services startup, has closed a $56 million funding round, confirming TechCrunch’s earlier report.

As per Agarwal, the quick home services platform has sharply scaled up over the past few months. “From 400 servicing jobs at the beginning of the fiscal year FY26, we closed the fiscal with about 40,000 servicing jobs on a daily basis. We manage to scale a 100X within the year,” he said.
Quick home services startup Snabbit has raised $56 Mn (about ₹527 Cr) in its Series D round co-led by Susquehanna Venture Capital, Mirae Asset Venture Investments and Bertelsmann India Investments.
